user.title: HomeKit Climate Proxy
user.description: Pick the climate entity whose fan speed does not work in HomeKit. A HomeKit-friendly copy of it is created.

mapping.title: Fan mode mapping
mapping.description: The entity reports these fan modes: {modes}. Each line maps one of them to a HomeKit name: auto, low, medium, high, on, off, or hide. The suggestion usually needs no change.

data.fan_mapping: Fan mode mapping (one 'Source: target' per line)
data.hide_hvac_modes: HVAC modes to hide from HomeKit (heat_cool = HomeKit's Auto)
data.mode_switches: Create Fan only and Dry switches (HomeKit thermostats have no such modes; the switches are the only way to reach them from the Home app)
data.switch_off_mode: When a Fan only / Dry switch is turned off
data.create_fan: Also create a separate fan accessory (off by default; the thermostat already has the fan speed)
data.fan_off_turns_off_climate: Turning the fan entity off turns the air conditioner off

error.invalid_mapping: Use one 'Source: target' per line; targets are auto, low, medium, high, on, off or hide.

abort.already_configured: This climate entity already has a proxy.
